scope: Actual final APK da1.b normal AKA Identity requests and z91 responses on Android ART. Exact original response bytes and da1.e transcript bytes checked across ordinary retransmissions, new requests and independent native sessions. No socket, APDU, challenge or live carrier operation.
verified: First actual AT_PERMANENT_ID_REQ records one exact request/response transcript pair
Three consecutive identical requests return the original response without appending transcript
Caller mutation of previously returned response or supplied request cannot contaminate the saved response/key
Normal lower-layer bytes beyond declared EAP Length do not create another identity exchange
New identifier and same identifier with a new valid AT_ANY_ID_REQ attribute use the native path and append their exact transcript pair
An older request after a newer exchange is processed natively again; only the latest request is replayed
Two fresh native da1 sessions with different synthetic permanent identities keep responses and transcripts isolated
Resetting the real ByteArrayOutputStream simulates native cleanup and invalidates the previous replay entry
limits: Tests use normal synthetic AKA Identity requests only; no EAP challenge/key derivation, SIM authentication, IKE/IMS registration, real call or audio is attempted.
The lifecycle case directly resets the real native transcript buffer; it does not run a full network-session shutdown.
No physical phone is attached; emulator-5580 is Android 11 API30 x86_64 with software acceleration.
No UI layout changed in this task, so no screenshots or visual regression tests were repeated.
